animal-care.title: Animal care and welfare
animal-care.summary: Support animals day to day and notice changes that matter.
animal-care.explanation: Animal care teams provide food, maintain habitats and observe behaviour and body condition. Care records help the team respond to changes and support conservation work without treating every species as if it has the same needs.

tasks.title: Provide daily care
tasks.detail: Follow prescribed diets and maintain clean, suitable habitats.

tasks.title: Observe and record
tasks.detail: Track behaviour, weight and body condition, and report changes to the team.

tasks.title: Work with specialists
tasks.detail: Support veterinary procedures and enrichment under established welfare and safety protocols.

animal-care.classroomConnection: Individual health and behaviour influence survival. Daily observations provide evidence, while population outcomes require follow-up beyond care.

work-bioprocess.title: Bioprocess development
work-bioprocess.summary: Develop repeatable ways to make and purify biological materials. This work connects molecular science to manufacturing conditions and checks whether a change improves the process.
work-bioprocess.explanation: Develop repeatable ways to make and purify biological materials. This work connects molecular science to manufacturing conditions and checks whether a change improves the process.

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Define a comparison between process conditions.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Track production and purification steps for each batch.

tasks.title: Explain and improve
tasks.detail: Use analytical results to decide which change to test next.

collaborators: Molecular scientists, analytical staff and quality teams
work-bioprocess.classroomConnection: Knowing a sequence or molecule is different from producing a reliable batch of it.

work-controls.title: Instrumentation and controls
work-controls.summary: Keep a process measurable and responsive. Controls work connects sensors, decisions and actuators so the system can respond when conditions change.
work-controls.explanation: Keep a process measurable and responsive. Controls work connects sensors, decisions and actuators so the system can respond when conditions change.

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Check whether sensors are reading reliably.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Compare measurements with the intended operating range.

tasks.title: Explain and improve
tasks.detail: Test how the system responds to a change or fault.

work-controls.classroomConnection: Feedback uses a measured result to inform the next action.

work-electrician.title: Electrician
work-electrician.summary: Build and check electrical installations using drawings, standards and trade procedures.
work-electrician.explanation: Build and check electrical installations using drawings, standards and trade procedures.

tasks.title: Read
tasks.detail: Interpret drawings and identify the intended circuit connections.

tasks.title: Install
tasks.detail: Fit and connect components using approved methods.

tasks.title: Verify
tasks.detail: Carry out permitted inspections and tests and document issues.

work-electrician.classroomConnection: A circuit diagram describes intended behaviour; installation and verification connect that model to a real system.

work-instrument.title: Instrument development and testing
work-instrument.summary: Help build and check the equipment that produces measurements. Instrument work joins hardware, software and experiments rather than treating a reading as automatically correct.
work-instrument.explanation: Help build and check the equipment that produces measurements. Instrument work joins hardware, software and experiments rather than treating a reading as automatically correct.

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Check performance using a known reference.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Investigate drift, noise or inconsistent readings.

tasks.title: Explain and improve
tasks.detail: Document tests so later users know what the instrument can establish.

collaborators: Scientists, electronics specialists and software developers
work-instrument.classroomConnection: Measurement uncertainty is part of using a tool responsibly.

work-lab.title: Laboratory analysis
work-lab.summary: Make measurements that other people can trust. A laboratory worker prepares samples, uses a method consistently and records enough detail for someone else to interpret the result.
work-lab.explanation: Make measurements that other people can trust. A laboratory worker prepares samples, uses a method consistently and records enough detail for someone else to interpret the result.

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Prepare and label samples so their identity is preserved.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Run comparisons or reference samples to check the method.

tasks.title: Explain and improve
tasks.detail: Record results, units and limitations before sharing findings.

collaborators: Scientists, process engineers and quality teams
work-lab.classroomConnection: A repeatable method and a fair comparison matter as much as a single impressive number.

work-logistics.title: Dispatch and logistics coordination
work-logistics.summary: Keep materials moving in the right order, with the information needed at each handoff.
work-logistics.explanation: Keep materials moving in the right order, with the information needed at each handoff.

tasks.title: Match
tasks.detail: Match deliveries or orders with available capacity.

tasks.title: Check
tasks.detail: Check timing, identification and handling requirements.

tasks.title: Respond
tasks.detail: Respond to a delay without losing track of the product or customer need.

work-logistics.classroomConnection: A technically sound product can still fail its purpose if timing or handling goes wrong.

work-machining.title: Machining and dimensional inspection
work-machining.summary: Make parts fit their intended purpose by controlling dimensions. Machining combines tools, setup and measurement; finishing a part is not the same as proving it meets its specification.
work-machining.explanation: Make parts fit their intended purpose by controlling dimensions. Machining combines tools, setup and measurement; finishing a part is not the same as proving it meets its specification.

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Interpret a drawing and plan a sequence of cuts.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Set up the machine and check the workpiece.

tasks.title: Explain and improve
tasks.detail: Measure critical dimensions and document deviations.

collaborators: Designers, production teams and quality inspectors
work-machining.classroomConnection: Tolerance describes an acceptable range rather than a perfectly exact number.

work-manufacturing.title: Manufacturing and quality work
work-manufacturing.summary: Make repeatable components and check that the output matches a specification.
work-manufacturing.explanation: Make repeatable components and check that the output matches a specification.

tasks.title: Read
tasks.detail: Read a drawing or work instruction before setting up a task.

tasks.title: Measure
tasks.detail: Measure key dimensions or properties and record the result.

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Investigate variation rather than treating every difference as acceptable.

work-manufacturing.classroomConnection: Precision, tolerances and repeatable methods connect measurement to useful products.

work-materials.title: Materials research and testing
work-materials.summary: Investigate whether a material improves a product for a defined purpose. A useful comparison separates the effect of the added material from other changes in the test.
work-materials.explanation: Investigate whether a material improves a product for a defined purpose. A useful comparison separates the effect of the added material from other changes in the test.

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Prepare comparable samples with and without an additive.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Measure a relevant property under consistent conditions.

tasks.title: Explain and improve
tasks.detail: Explain performance changes alongside uncertainty and practical constraints.

collaborators: Chemists, process engineers and product developers
work-materials.classroomConnection: Stronger, lighter and more conductive are different properties requiring different tests.

work-mechanical.title: Mechanical design and prototyping
work-mechanical.summary: Translate a need into a component or machine that can be built and tested. Designers use dimensions, material properties and constraints to evaluate alternatives.
work-mechanical.explanation: Translate a need into a component or machine that can be built and tested. Designers use dimensions, material properties and constraints to evaluate alternatives.

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Create and revise drawings or a digital model.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Choose materials and dimensions for the intended conditions.

tasks.title: Explain and improve
tasks.detail: Compare the prototype with its requirements and refine the design.

collaborators: Machinists, fabricators, test staff and customers
work-mechanical.classroomConnection: Geometry, forces and material properties shape real design trade-offs.

work-millwright.title: Industrial machinery assembly and maintenance
work-millwright.summary: Make machinery work together as a physical system. Millwright work connects assembly, alignment, inspection and troubleshooting.
work-millwright.explanation: Make machinery work together as a physical system. Millwright work connects assembly, alignment, inspection and troubleshooting.

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Read equipment drawings and plan assembly steps.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Align and connect mechanical components.

tasks.title: Explain and improve
tasks.detail: Check operation and record problems that need adjustment.

collaborators: Designers, operators, electricians and fabrication teams
work-millwright.classroomConnection: Small alignment errors can change how forces and motion pass through a machine.

work-power.title: Power-electronics design
work-power.summary: Control how electrical energy moves between components. Power-electronics work combines circuit design with testing, thermal limits and the behaviour of the complete system.
work-power.explanation: Control how electrical energy moves between components. Power-electronics work combines circuit design with testing, thermal limits and the behaviour of the complete system.

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Choose and document a circuit design.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Test its response across operating conditions.

tasks.title: Explain and improve
tasks.detail: Investigate losses and component limits before revising the design.

collaborators: Electrical technologists, firmware developers and manufacturing teams
work-power.classroomConnection: Power describes the rate of energy transfer; stored energy describes how much is available.

work-quality.title: Quality and traceability
work-quality.summary: Make it possible to explain how a result or product was produced. Quality work checks records, methods and acceptance criteria so variation can be investigated rather than hidden.
work-quality.explanation: Make it possible to explain how a result or product was produced. Quality work checks records, methods and acceptance criteria so variation can be investigated rather than hidden.

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Check that materials and samples have traceable identities.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Compare recorded results with defined acceptance criteria.

tasks.title: Explain and improve
tasks.detail: Investigate deviations and document what changed.

collaborators: Production, laboratory, engineering and customer teams
work-quality.classroomConnection: Repeated results need both measurements and records of the conditions that produced them.

work-software.title: Software and data systems
work-software.summary: Build the tools that move, process and display information. Reliable software needs testing against missing, delayed and unexpected data as well as ideal examples.
work-software.explanation: Build the tools that move, process and display information. Reliable software needs testing against missing, delayed and unexpected data as well as ideal examples.

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Translate a user need into a testable behaviour.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Build and test a data-processing or display feature.

tasks.title: Explain and improve
tasks.detail: Investigate failures and document assumptions about inputs.

collaborators: Domain experts, designers, users and hardware teams
work-software.classroomConnection: An algorithm’s output depends on the quality and meaning of its inputs.

work-spatial.title: Spatial data and mapping
work-spatial.summary: Turn measurements tied to places into usable spatial information. The work involves coordinates, scale and checking that datasets describe the same location and time.
work-spatial.explanation: Turn measurements tied to places into usable spatial information. The work involves coordinates, scale and checking that datasets describe the same location and time.

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Check coordinate systems and measurement dates.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Align and inspect spatial datasets.

tasks.title: Explain and improve
tasks.detail: Present maps or models with their limitations.

collaborators: Surveyors, engineers, field operators and software teams
work-spatial.classroomConnection: Models can be detailed while still containing gaps or misaligned measurements.

work-technical-support.title: Technical application support
work-technical-support.summary: Help people use a technical product in the conditions of their own workplace.
work-technical-support.explanation: Help people use a technical product in the conditions of their own workplace.

tasks.title: Ask

tasks.title: Separate
tasks.detail: Separate a setup problem from a sensor or process problem.

tasks.title: Explain
tasks.detail: Explain the next diagnostic step and record what changed.

work-technical-support.classroomConnection: Troubleshooting means testing explanations one at a time.

new-plant-biotechnology.explanation: Investigate how plant characteristics relate to biological information and growing conditions.
